title: Refund Policy & Process
content: Customers can request a full refund within 14 days of purchase if they are unsatisfied. To request a refund, go to Account Settings > Billing History, select the invoice, and click 'Request Refund'. Refunds take 3-5 business days to process back to the original payment method.

title: Failed Payment or Credit Card Declined
content: If your credit card or automated subscription payment fails, check if the card has expired or reached daily transaction limits. Update your credit card details under Account Settings > Payment Methods. Retries are attempted automatically after 24 hours.

title: Downgrading or Canceling Subscription
content: You can downgrade or cancel your active subscription anytime. Go to Billing > Plan Management > Cancel Plan. Your current plan features remain active until the end of your current billing cycle. No prorated refunds are given for partial months unless within the 14-day refund window.

title: Invoice & Tax Receipt Download
content: Official VAT/GST tax invoices are generated automatically at the end of each billing cycle. Download PDF receipts from Billing > Invoices. If you need custom tax IDs added to your invoices, update your Billing Address Profile.

title: Password Reset & Account Lockout
content: If you forgot your password or got locked out after 5 failed attempts, click 'Forgot Password' on the login screen. Enter your registered email to receive a secure reset link valid for 30 minutes. Check spam folders if the email doesn't arrive within 2 minutes.

title: API Rate Limits & 429 Quota Exceeded
content: HTTP 429 errors mean your application has exceeded rate limits. Free tier accounts have a limit of 60 requests per minute, while Pro tier accounts support up to 1,000 requests per minute. Implement exponential backoff retry logic or upgrade to Enterprise for dedicated throughput.

title: Webhook Delivery Failures & Signatures
content: If webhooks are failing, check your endpoint returns HTTP 200 within 5 seconds. Failed webhook events are retried up to 5 times with exponential backoff. Ensure HMAC SHA256 signature header verification matches your endpoint secret key.

title: Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) Setup & Recovery
content: Enable 2FA via Authenticator App (Google Authenticator, Authy, or 1Password) under Security Settings. Store your 16-character backup recovery codes in a safe place. If you lost your phone without backup codes, contact security support for identity verification.

title: SDK Integration & CORS Errors
content: Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) errors occur when making client-side API calls from unauthorized domains. Add your web domain origin in Developer Dashboard > CORS Settings. For mobile/desktop SDK integrations, ensure you use server-side proxy tokens.

title: System Status & Scheduled Maintenance
content: Check operational status of all services, API endpoints, and database clusters at status.example.com. Maintenance windows are scheduled on Sundays from 02:00 UTC to 04:00 UTC and announced 48 hours in advance.

title: Enterprise Custom SLA & Support Response Times
content: Standard support operates Monday to Friday, 9 AM - 6 PM EST with a 24-hour SLA. Enterprise plan customers receive priority 24/7 dedicated support with a guaranteed 1-hour SLA for critical incidents.

title: Data Privacy & GDPR / SOC2 Compliance
content: We are SOC 2 Type II certified and fully compliant with GDPR and CCPA regulations. User data is encrypted at rest using AES-256 and in transit via TLS 1.3. You can request a complete data export or right-to-be-forgotten deletion from Privacy Settings.

title: Team Member Roles & Workspace Permissions
content: Workspace admins can invite team members and assign roles: Admin (full access), Developer (API & integrations access), or Viewer (read-only metrics). Go to Workspace Settings > Team Members to manage seats.

title: Custom Integration & Professional Services
content: Need help setting up custom integrations or migrating enterprise workloads? Our Professional Services engineering team offers dedicated onboarding, custom ETL pipelines, and architecture reviews. Contact sales@example.com.
